notes.title: 1.24 Mutation Cards Visual Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Team's Thoughts[/h1][list]
	This week we put a little break on our Ascention implementation to look into some visual aspects of the game, let us know your opinion on those.
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]New Mutation Card Visuals[/h2][list]
		[*]Changes depending on how you obtained such mutation
		[*]5 Different backgrounds: Regular, Random, Free, Sigil and Creative
	[/list]
	[h2]New Crisis Dial[/h2][list]
		[*]The Crisis drawer now uses a dial instead of a number to show the current crisis duration
		[*]If Cernunnos' Omen mutation is active, the drawer is always open
	[/list]
	[h2]New Steam Achievements[/h2][list]
		[*]There is now an achievement for every ascention level beaten
		[*]If you already did them in the past, completing an Ascention V run should give you all of them
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1][list]
	[*]Made some changes to save files, new save files should be up to 90% smaller and up to 1000% faster to load
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed flowers behaving weirdly on the first day of a transition before any change was made to leaves
	[*]Fixed some mutation tooltips not displaying the mutation card properly
[/list]

notes.title: Ascention V
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]Ascention V: Woeful Clouds[/h2]
	[h2]Ascention IV Mutations[/h2][list]
		[h3]Slow Metabolism[/h3][list]
			[*]Shaded Leaves use less water
			[*]Only available in Ascention IV+
		[/list]
		[h3]Begonia's Lesson[/h3][list]
			[*]Leaf tiles bloom when shaded during the summer
			[*]Only available in Ascention IV+
		[/list]
		[h3]Structuring[/h3][list]
			[*]When a leaf tile is placed with enough shading, it also creates a stem tile in its position
			[*]Only available in Ascention IV+
		[/list]
		[h3]Recluse Paradise[/h3][list]
			[*]  Shading radius is increased by 1
			[*]This mutation stores every energy that is not generated due to shading and reduces leaf energy costs based on how much energy it has stored.
			[*]Only available in Ascention IV+
		[/list]
		[h3]Local Climate[/h3][list]
			[*]Shaded leaves have a chance of not decaying
			[*]Only available in Ascention IV+
		[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1][list]
	[*]Graphic Engine entirelly rewritten
	[*]Removed the option to turn off dynamic tiles
	[*]Framerate is no longer dependant on camera position
	[*]Entering a page with too many icons no longer freezes the screen until they are loaded
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
	[h2]Gameplay[/h2][list]
		[*]Human greed now affects neighbor trees in Ascention II+
	[/list]
	[h2]Visual[/h2][list]
		[*]Mist is now animated again
		[*]Enemy tiles are now animated
		[*]Ascention I+ unknown tiles are know animated
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]All the stuff that Verde broke during the Graphic Engine rework
[/list]

notes.title: Our leaves will block the sun
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]Ascention IV: Dense Foliage[/h2]
	[h2]Ascention III mutations[/h2][list]
		[*][h3]Circle of Life[/h3][list]
			When a stem tile is destroyed, a leaf tile is placed in its place
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Recycling[/h3][list]
			When a stem tile is destroyed, you gain its capacity in energy.
			Stem tiles placed within the last 10 turns generate less energy.
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Offering[/h3][list]
			If 50 stem tiles are destroyed, 3 sigils are placed on the map and this mutation is removed
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Ironwood[/h3][list]
			Stem tiles have increased health and regenerate faster
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Pyre[/h3][list]
			For every 100 stem tiles destroyed, all your tiles gain 1 cold resistance
		[/list]
	[/list]
	[h2]New Voice Lines[/h2][list]
		6 new voice lines are now in the game
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
	[*][h2]Mutation Drawing Rework[/h2][list]
		Mutations now use an entirely different shader and drawing methods.
		Mutation icons are now dynamically loaded, this should reduce load times and allow people to turn "noicons" off
	[/list]
	[*][h2]Flowers now use dynamic textures[/h2][list]
		Neighbors now use different colors and textures
	[/list]
	[*][h2]Tooltip Rework[/h2][list]
		Tooltip visuals changed to reflect the change in mutation drawing
		Tooltips can no longer conflict with subtitles or other UI elements such as drawers
		Mutation tooltips show their mutation on the background
	[/list]
	
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Neighbor trees are now properly flammable
[/list]

notes.title: Ascention III: Fragile Bark
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]Ascention III: Fragile Bark[/h2][list]
		As per usual, to avoid spoilers I'll not post more info about the new Ascention level here.
		Let me know what you think about this in the comments!
	[/list]
	[h2]New Mutations[/h2][list]
		[*][h3]Entangled Roots[/h3][list]
			Allows you to place roots on other tree's root tiles
			Only Available in Ascention II: Selfish Neighbors
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Cross Pollination[/h3][list]
			Increases flower generation based on the number of leaf tiles from other trees
			Only Available in Ascention II: Selfish Neighbors
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Respectful Twigs[/h3][list]
			Other trees relocate when nearby your stems
			Only Available in Ascention II: Selfish Neighbors
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Comforting Canopy[/h3][list]
			Comforting Canopy
			Only Available in Ascention II: Selfish Neighbors
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Eyes in the Forest[/h3][list]
			Other tree's roots also reveal tiles
			Only Available in Ascention II: Selfish Neighbors
		[/list]
	[/list]
	[h2]New Launch Options[/h2][list]
		[*]"version": displays a line of text with the current version in the bottom left of the menu
		[*]"noicons": loads the game without loading mutation icons
	[/list]
	[h2]Quality of Life additions[/h2][list]
		[*]Added a tooltip opacity slider in configs[list]
			Suggestion from a user in our discord channel
		[/list]
		[*]Added a tooltip size slider in configs
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list]
	[*][h3]Most crises now have a 1 year cooldown[/h3][list]
		[*]With the exceptions being "Flood" and "Drought"
	[/list]
	[*]"Sensory Roots" mutation is now retroactive
	[*]"Water Sense" mutation is now retroactive
	[*]"Nutrient Zones" mutation strength reduced by 10%[list]
		This should still be way stronger than before because now every nutrient patch is always within bounds
	[/list]
	[*]"Regretful Growth" mutation no longer triggers "Intervention" mutation[list]
		Thanks to our community for helping us find this exploit
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1][list]
	[*]Tiles can no longer be placed outside of bounds by any means[list]
		This should result in smaller file sizes since there will be no aquifers/rocks/nutrients outside of bounds
	[/list]
	[*]Fire tiles should no longer lag the game in large quantities[list]
		Steam Community strikes again, helping Verde find this one out with their save files
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed bounties and collection tooltips not showing up on some screens
	[*]Fixed "Underwater Reserves" not working properly
	[*]Initial root on Ascention 1+ will now reveal the area around itself
	[*]Fixed weird graphics when restarting the game with Ascention 1 active
[/list]

notes.title: 1.19: Selfish Neighbors update
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]New Ascention level[/h2][list]
		Called Selfish Neighbors
	[/list]
	[h2]Ascention Mutations[/h2][list]

	[/list]
	[h2]New Mutations[/h2][list]
		[*][h3]Knowledge is Power[/h3][list]
			For every 25 tiles revealed, increases energy generation by 1%
			Only Available in Ascention I: Mysterious Soil
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Divination[/h3][list]
			Reveals the position of every sigil on the map
			Only Available in Ascention I: Mysterious Soil			
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Unseen Treasures[/h3][list]

			Only Available in Ascention I: Mysterious Soil
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Water Sense[/h3][list]

			Only Available in Ascention I: Mysterious Soil
		[/list]
		[*][h3]Sensory Roots[/h3][list]

		[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2][list]
	[h3]Creative mode[/h3][list]
		[*]Creative "Add Mutation" menu no longer shows restricted mutations
		[*]Creative "Remove Mutation" menu now only shows mutations that you currently have

	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
	[*]Restart button on death screen should now keep Ascention

	[*]Mist tiles should no longer lag the game

[/list]

notes.title: Towards the sun we ascend
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]Ascention[/h2][list]
		Added a new game mode: Ascention.
		You can unlock this game mode by beating the game once in the Speed Sprout difficulty.
		The game mode includes cumulative modifiers that each make your game a little harder.
		There is only one modifier within the game, but more should come out in the following weeks.
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list]
	[*]Sigils identification range increased from 2 to 3 tiles
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1][list]
	[*]Magic 8 Ball widget now interrupts the narrator and ignores the narrator's cooldown
	[*]Magic 8 Ball widget internal cooldown reduced from 120 frames to 0.5 seconds
	[*]Sigils now emit a glowing sphere when revealed and when a root is first placed in a radius of 10 tiles
	[*]UI no longers plays the game start the animation on restarting
	[*]Limited zoom on touch devices
	[*]Camera no longer drags while dragging widgets
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Crisis drawer animation is no longer frame dependant
	[*]Second bloom chances are now correctly saved
	[*]Turn log window size now scales with screen size
	[*]Mutation menu window size now scales with screen size
	[*]Fixed a bug that would make the camera teleport after selecting a tile on touch screen devices
	[*]Multiple end turns can no longer be queued
	[*]Turn log windows can no longer be queued
	[*]Flying resource particles should no longer have strange paths when fps is low
[/list]

notes.title: Changes to Bounties and optimizations
notes.content:
[h1]Team's Thoughts[/h1][list]
	More and more development on the mobile port: Some optional optimisations and touch screen interactions are the core of today's update.
[/list]

[h1]Update 1.17[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]General Loading Procedure[/h2][list]
		[*]The loading screen now shows precisely what it doing instead of what general file was last loaded
		[*]Now the game also frees resources that are no longer needed during the load process itself, lowering overall memory usage.
	[/list]
	[h2]Low Memory and Low Shaders accessibility modes[/h2][list]
		[*]Can be entered by adding "lowmem" and "lowsha" to the launch options on steam properties
		[*]Low Memory mode can reduce the total amount of graphic memory the game uses by 90%, but has significant impacts on game visuals
		[*]Low Shaders mode disables the heaviest shaders in the game, like clouds and blur
		[*]When opening the game on an Android device, both Low Memory and Low Shaders are enabled by default
	[/list]
	[h2]New Ways of moving the camera[/h2][list]
		[*]When not selecting any tile to place, the left mouse button can also be used to drag the camera around
		[*]If your device supports touch, you can now zoom in and out by pinching
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
	[h2]Bounties[/h2][list]
		[*]You now have to click them to gather their reward in fruit.
		[*]The main menu button now shows if a bounty can be claimed.
		[*]Now there is a fruit count in the bounties screen
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed some graphic elements not properly scaling with UI scale[list]
		This includes tooltips, default game communication and subtitles
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Small Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed Bazaar Shortcut on the death screen
	[*]Fruit gathering animation no longer is accelerated by animation speed
	[*]UI Sliding animation speed no longer is dependant on FPS
	[*]Fixed Bazaar and Bounties screens not showing properly in some devices
	[*]Fixed game launching in the wrong language in some conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Two updates one post: second bloom and turn log widgets
notes.content:
[h1]Team Thoughts[/h1][list]
	This update features tons of small changes and fixes as Verde decided to take every small task on the list instead of doing the big ones first.
	
	We also ran some tests for a possible mobile port, while we were able to make the game run smoothly on a simulated android, there are some changes that have to be made before it is possible to play the game normally on a touch-screen device.
	
	We also noticed that we didn't release the patch notes on steam last week, so this post will contain both of them
[/list]

[h1]Update 1.16[/h1]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
	[h2]Second Bloom Rework[/h2][list]
		Second Bloom now uses probability instead of being only dependent on your actions
		When winter ends, the chance is at 100%, and halves for every determined mutation purchased using flowers
		"Everbloom" mutation reworked to make the game roll for this twice instead of once
		Now there's a widget that explains the mechanic and shows the current probability
	[/list]
	[h2]Reworked Cold Mists[/h2][list]
		Now uses a different algorithm in order to place the mists, this new algorithm should place and remove mist tiles linearly over the duration of the crisis
		That means that 2 days of cold mists now have very close to double the number of mist tiles of a single day
		Mist tiles now dissipate during the spring and summer instead of only summer, but it still dissipates faster during the summer
		The new algorithm recycles mist tiles between turns so that it doesn't flood the turn log
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Small Changes[/h1][list]
	[*]The two initial tiles are now completely indestructible
	[*]The Bazaar now glows purple if you have enough fruit to purchase anything
	[*]Changed outdated tips on the death screen
	[*]Changed default narrator cooldown from 120 to 15 seconds
	[*]Added a shortcut to the Bazaar on the death screen
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed bounties tooltips being wrongly positioned on big screens
	[*]Fixed collection tooltips being wrongly positioned on big screens
	[*]Fixed the "Main Menu" button on the death screen restarting the game instead of going back to the main menu
	[*]Fixed winter costs not showing on turn log
	[*]Fixed achievements and fruit only being given to the player after the Freeplay prompt
	[*]Fixed narrator spamming only idle lines if narrator cooldown is higher than the idle timer
[/list]

[h1]Update 1.15[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[*]Added a new Widget, turn log, that can be clicked to reveal everything that happened during the last turn
	[*]Added a narrator cooldown slider to the audio configs
	[*]Added a sign that informs the player about the widget system, it only appears when the right section of the widget bar is empty.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
	[*]Sliders on the config menu now contain their current value below them
	[*]Moved speedometer and winter widgets back to their original position so that the new sign is visible to new players
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed configs not saving when exiting the config menu
	[*]Fixed human greed accounting mist tiles as target tiles
	[*]Fixed human greed not updating properly when the turn started
	[*]Fixed human greed leaving parts of your tree red if it is interrupted
[/list]

notes.title: Polish, polish and polish
notes.content:
[h1]Team's Thoughts[/h1][list]
	Recently we noticed that some features of the game were frequently going unnoticed by new players, so we plan on fixing these issues before adding more content to the game.
	Sadly these changes usually take time to plan and implement, so it is taking time, but we hope that what you can do within the game is more straightforward for our saplings.
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[*]Added an animation when fruit is obtained
	[*]Added a toggle in the performance tab for turning off dynamic grass
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1][list]
	[*]When choosing the game mode, a third scroll will now appear with the game mode's description
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
	[*]Fixed text in Freeplay prompt being behind buttons
	[*]Bear fruit button on Freeplay prompt now takes you to the main menu
	[*]Fixed a strange interaction between "Nature's Attendants" mutation and the "Cold Mist" crisis that caused the Attendants to be placed anywhere on the map
	[*]Events that should trigger when winter ends no longer happen at the start of the last day of winter
[/list]

notes.title: Fixing balance and balancing fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]Team's Thoughts[/h1][list]
	While this update doesn't introduce any new features, it brings some well-needed fixes and balance changes to the table.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list]
	With the change to how crises work, several mutations became useless after a certain date. To counteract this, some were limited to only showing up in earlier parts of the game while others were completely reworked, here is the list:[list]
	[*][h3]'A Mask for Every Leaf' no longer shows up after year 2.[/h3]
	[*][h3]'Touch of the Fae' no longer shows up after year 2.[/h3]
	[*][h3]'Wax-Covered Leaves' Reworked[/h3][list]
		When a leaf is going to be destroyed, it has a 50% chance of extending its life by 1 turn
		Still triggers on leaf destroyed effects, like 'Yggdrasil' or 'Resin Layers'
	[/list]
	[*][h3]'Reactive Hydration' Reworked[/h3][list]
		Now an active mutation, can be clicked to extinguish all fire tiles
		Every fire tile extinguished this way costs 5 water
		Typo removed
	[/list]
	[*][h3]'Pocket Apple Juice' Reworked[/h3][list]
		When a leaf tile is destroyed, gain water.
	[/list]
	[*][h3]'Flapping Aid' Reworked[/h3][list]
		Can be clicked once per year to set the crisis of the current day to 'Parasites'
		Parasites give 1-20 energy and water when destroyed.
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list]
	[*]Repeated mutations now stack in a single card
	[*]Burls now has the number of Burls noted within your card
	[*]Speedometer widget default position changed
	[*]Winter widget default position changed
	[*]Fire tooltips now includes that leaves make fire spread
	[*]Fixed on-game-start narration starting when the game is launched
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[*]Grass
[/list]

notes.title: Better grab a coat, winter will be rough
notes.content:
[h1]Team's Thoughts[/h1]
Verde is experimenting a little bit with the format of the patch notes, as to title, subtitle and whatnots.
This update and the next one will probably introduce a bit more difficulty to the game to account for something we have planned for 1.15

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[h2]Winter Crises[/h2][list]
There are 3 new crises that only come up during winter. They were designed to be relatively tame because winter is already rough enough, but to bring some new challenges.
[*][h3]Regression[/h3][list]
Removes some of the most recent stems placed.
This cannot remove all stem tiles of your tree.
[/list]
[*][h3]Frozen Aquifers[/h3][list]
Aquifers are randomly frozen.
They unfreeze during summer.
[/list]
[*][h3]Cold Mist[/h3][list]
A new tile, Mist, is placed around the map.
Mist tiles reduce heavily the efficiency of leaves.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list]
[*]Water reserves now works properly with large amounts of water gained at once
[*]Crises now last for 1 more day on Speed Sprout and Creation game modes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2][list]
[h3]Two new crises[/h3][list]
[*]Lethargy: During this crisis, energy costs increase by 1000.
[*]Cold Snap: During this crisis, winter per turn cost is applied to your tree.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list]
[h3]Tiered Crises[/h3][list]
Every crisis has a specific year, and it only appears during that specific year.

Here is a table with every year and what crisis can happen during it:

[table]
[tr][th]Year[/th][th]Crisis List[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]1[/td][td]Drought, Flood, Heat Wave, Insect Swarm, Strong Winds[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]2[/td][td]Drought, Flood, Human Greed, Parasites, Pollution[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]3[/td][td]Drought, Flood, Thunderstorm, Cold Snap[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]4[/td][td]Drought, Flood, Lethargy, Pesticides, Cold Snap[/td][/tr]
[/table]

Every year after the fourth is treated as a repeated fourth year in crisis chance calculations
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[*][h2]Creation Mode[/h2][list]
		You can now unlock the creation mode on the Bazaar for 100 fruit
		In the creation mode, you have access to 5 special mutations that bend the reality to your will.
	[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[*][h2]Bounties[/h2][list]
		As an alternative method of gathering fruit, you can now complete some tough challenges present within the bounties screen.
		10 Different challenges with 3 levels of difficulty for each of them, with 500 total fruit to be obtained.
	[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
[h1]Team's Thoughts[/h1][list]
	While the bazaar marked the beggining of the transition of the game from roguelike to roguelite, we noticed that we had two conflicting ideas about how to handle out-of-game progression: Unlocks and Bazaar.
	Our current plans are to unify them. To achieve this goal, unlocks were temporarily removed so they can be reintroduced later as bounties, generating fruit instead of simply giving you a mutation.
	We also want to keep exacly 100 mutations in the game as it starts out, so we moved a few mutations from the starting pool to the bazaar.
[/list]	
	
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]Bazaar Mutations[/h2][list]
		[*]You can now unlock new mutations in the bazaar.
	[/list]
	[h2]New mutations[/h2][list]
		[h3]Seasonal Fires[/h3][list]
			[*]Allows you to set your tree on fire once per year.
			[*]Fire no longer destroys stem tiles, instead, it increases their cold resistance
		[/list]
		[h3]Energy Interests[/h3][list]
			[*]Every turn, you gain 1% of your current energy as energy
			[*]Triggers after the turn happens
		[/list]
		[h3]Fashion Coat[/h3][list]
			[*]All stem tiles gain 0.1 cold resistance for every 100 flowers spent after getting this mutation
		[/list]
		[h3]Cold Storage[/h3][list]
			[*]Increases stem capacity by their cold resistance
		[/list]
		[h3]Energetic Aquifers[/h3][list]
			[*]Aquifers also generate energy
		[/list]
		[h3]Deja vu[/h3][list]
			[*]Consumable
			[*]Go one season back in time
		[/list]
		[h3]Time Loop[/h3][list]
			[*]50% chance of triggering every on-turn mutation every turn
			[*]Can trigger itself
		[/list]
		[h3]Energetic Bloom[/h3][list]
			[*]+10% energy generation
			[*]You can click this mutation, spending flowers and buffing its value
		[/list]
		[h3]Summer Sale[/h3][list]
			[*]Shop prices are halved during the summer
		[/list]
		[h3]Energy Credit[/h3][list]
			[*]You can click this mutation to fill your capacity with energy
			[*]It takes every new energy you generate, you can use it again as soon as you pay it back
		[/list]
	[/list]
	[h2]New Elixir[/h2][list]
		[h3]Elixir of Genetic Variety[/h3][list]
			[*]For the duration of the run, all random mutations from the shop are free
			[*]Winner of the discord poll
		[/list]
	[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
	[*]Shop mutations no longer go away after purchasing the first one
	[*]Configs are now saved properly
	[*]All buttons on the menu should properly show up
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
	[h2]The Bazaar[/h2][list]
		[*]Every winter survived, you gain a number of fruits proportional to the current year and difficulty.
		[*]In this screen, you can use those fruits to purchase things to help your tree grow.
		[*]There are currently only elixirs available, but we have some plans on what to introduce in the updates to come.
	[/list]
	[h2]Elixirs[/h2][list]
		[*]Can be purchased in the Bazaar for prices from 4 to 24 fruits.
		[*]They last one run and don't stack, but their effects can be quite dramatic:
		[h3]Elixir of Steady Growth[/h3][list]
			For the first year, energy costs don't increase.
		[/list]
		[h3]Elixir of Sprouting[/h3][list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 is here.
notes.content:
[h1]Teams Thoughts[/h1]
To avoid making a way too big announcement here and to be able to answer everyone's questions adequately, Verde will be posting detailed information about the mechanic changes soon in the Community Hub, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1653100/discussions/0/3271309684523028773]you can find it here.[/url]

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[h2]10 New Mutations[/h2][list]
Two of them are locked behind new unlocks. Detailed information about them in the in-depth post in the community hub
[/list]
[h2]Late game crises[/h2][list]
We've noticed from your feedback that the game was pending towards the easier side as the years go by, so we figured out we could give it a little twist with some strong crises that only happen from the third year onwards.

With the two new crises: Thunderstorm and Harmful Pesticides, winning should not be taken for granted after the second year. More about them in the community hub.
[/list]
[h2]New Widgets[/h2][list]
With both of them being player suggestions from the community hub, we introduced a capacity meter to show how many resources your tree can hold and a Winter Intensity predictor that tells you exactly how cruel the next winter is going to be.
[/list]
[h2]Cold Resistance mechanic[/h2][list]
Several mutations used to reduce how much winter drained energy on specific stem tiles, however, this was severely inconsistent.

We introduced a mechanic to unify all of these, more details will be included in the in-depth post.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1][list]
[h2]Changed shop and Winter scalings[/h2][list]
While the first year remained untouched, from the third year and onwards the shop should have higher prices and winter starts getting harder in the second year.

These changes should affect all game modes but are way easier to notice on the Speed Sprout(aka hard) 
[/list]
[h2]New Loss Condition[/h2][list]
Having no stem tiles now means you are dead

Old loss conditions still apply.
[/list]
[h2]Small changes[/h2][list]
Resilience can no longer make a crisis shorter than one day
Beacon of Eden effect: 2 -> 1
Pollution cost increase: +1 -> x2
Removed a bug that made Junipery apply 9 times
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list]
[h2]Visual changes[/h2][list]
Several visual changes were made in an attempt to make the game visual less noisy overall.

What do you think about these changes? Do you like them? Do you hate them? Let us know.
[/list]
[h2]Auto leaf replacement[/h2][list]
Now it is way faster and should work properly with the Amazonian Canopy mutation.
[/list]
[h2]Flying resources[/h2][list]
Now have a less predictable path towards their objective, they should orbit their objective a bit before going in.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
Fixed unlocks menu not being able to display a big number of unlocks
Reduced the amount of floating leaf tiles
[/list]

notes.title: Heliotropism 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Verde's Thoughts[/h1]
It's been a long journey. About one year ago, Heliotropism was being conceptualised by two friends in a game jam. After all this time working hard on what we've got, building a small team and aspiring towards a great day. Today is that great day. Several things have been improved and now we are finally able to move out of early access and present you with Heliotropism!

The game will continue moving forwards and being updated further as we still plan on adding more and more content to it, but we believe we've got our foundation well-rooted and it is time to start moving towards the sun.

Now, without further redo, time for the patch notes:

[h1]What's new[/h1]

[h2]Terrain[/h2][list]
[*]Earth is no longer flat!
[*]Lakes and mountains now fill the landscape with challenges and opportunities
[*]You can place roots on lakes to get some water from them
[/list]

[h2]New UI is here[/h2][list]
[*]With a new rustic style, you can now adjust the position of several UI elements called widgets
[*]These new widgets are capable of changing the way you play quite dramatically, so take your time to try them out
[/list]

[h2]Weather[/h2][list]
[*]Now the clouds mean something instead of being static on the sky.
[*]It can now rain, rain makes your leaves consume less water, but also generate less energy.
[*]Weather is influenced by season and future crises, so if your summer is unexpectedly dry, you can bet there is a drought coming
[/list]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2][list]
[*]Several balance changes were made so that the game actually gets harder as the years go
[*]Now seasonal drawbacks scale with the current year, and be ready for some really harsh winters later on.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Added some widgets to improve quality of life, like automatic leaf replacement, animation speed regulator, weather indicator and more
[*]A game end screen was added, it includes some statistics about your run and some tips about how to improve your tree-building abilities
[*]New music for every season but winter, just to keep things fresh
[/list]

[h2]Sigils[/h2][list]
[*]Several glowing objects are scattered across the underground
[*]Once approached, they reveal a mutation
[*]Once touched, they give you that mutation
[/list]

[h2]New Shop[/h2][list]
[*]The shop can now be accessed at any time, allowing you to purchase things at any moment you so desire
[*]Its contents refresh during the winter so that you can buy new things by the spring
[/list]

[h2]New mutations[/h2][list]
[*]We introduced a grand total of 23 new mutations to the game
[*]8 of them have to be unlocked to be used
[/list]

[h2]Unlocks[/h2][list]
[*]A new system in place that brings to the table some out-of-game progression
[*]As you do the determined tasks, you unlock new mutations to help you further improve your tree-growing endeavours
[*]Up until now, every single one of them can be obtained in every game mode
[/list]

[h2]Game modes[/h2][list]
[*]There are now 3 game modes, which modify various aspects of the game
[*]They influence how many days you got in each season and also how hard can the game be
[/list]

notes.title: Heliotropism: The World is Beautiful update beta
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
[h2]New UI[/h2][list]
[*]We tried to integrate some aspects of the game in a little more seamless way on the new UI, while still trying to match that wooden board visual.
[/list]

[h2]New Shop and mutations[/h2][list]
[*]The shop can now be opened at any time, its contents change during the winter.
[*]Mutations are now cards instead of tokens
[*]Some mutations can be interacted with, those are placed on the left side of the board and are tinted blue
[*]Some mutations that had a one-time effect when obtained now have that effect when interacted with, those being: Abundance of Energy, Abundance of Water and Uprooted Thoughts
[*]Every spring, a random mutation from the crisis mitigation pool is obtained
[/list]

[h2]New terrain[/h2][list]
[*]The terrain is no longer a straight line, instead, it is procedurally generated and contains some new features
[*][h3]Sigils[/h3][list]
[*]Found among rocks in the underground
[*]These sigils turn into mutations once approached 
[*]Can be obtained by growing a root over them
[/list]
[*][h3]Water[/h3][list]
[*]Found near the surface where the terrain is below certain heights.
[*]Roots can grow on it and generate extra water when on them
[*]We have some plans to lower/heighten the map's water level via crises and/or mutations, but currently it is static during the whole playthrough
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Game Modes[/h2][list]
[*]There are now 3 game modes to fit more diverse playstyles
[*]Game modes affect season duration and sigil frequency
[/list]

[h2]New graphics[/h2][list]
[*][h3]Clouds[/h3][list]
[*]Replaced the old static sky with something a little more dynamic
[*]Cloud intensity and movement change over time and are affected by the current season
[*]In the future, cloud intensity and movement will also be affected by current and future crises
[/list]
[*][h3]Roots and Stems[/h3][list]
[*]Roots and Stems will now change their widths based on their placement on the tree
[*]Stems have now a slightly different texture
[/list][/list]

[h1]What's Planned[/h1][list]
[*][h2]Creative mode[/h2][list]
[*]A mode where you take control over the game.
[*]The player will have infinite resources, be able to change seasons at will and obtain any mutations they desire.
[*]Best environment for gardening.
[/list]
[*][h2]Achievements and Unlocks[/h2][list]
[*]A complete overhaul of the achievements system, with some new mutations locked behind some.
[/list]
[*][h2]Transformations[/h2][list]
[*]Optional transformations will be available to the tree once it obtains certain mutation combinations
[*]Once transformed, your growth starts anew, with all of the mutations of the previous tree
[*]These will not only change the entire visual of the tree, as well as change core rules of the game
[/list]
[*][h2]~20 new mutations[/h2][list]
[*]With all of the features added in this update, more ways of obtaining mutations were added and the current mutation pool became insufficient
[*]We plan on adding around 20 mutations to the game, with the first one already included in this beta
[/list]
[*][h2]UI changes[/h2][list]
[*][h3]Empty space[/h3][list]
[*]Currently, there is some empty space in the UI and we plan on having it filled with the following:
[*]A game log button, which opens a screen describing exactly what happened on that last turn
[*]A game speed toggle, to change the speed of the animations of most of the game
[*]We are also open to suggestions, what information do you think is critical to your playstyle?
[/list]
[*][h3]Tooltips[/h3][list]
[*]There are still some tooltips missing or misplaced, those being:
[*]Crisis tooltip is currently misplaced
[*] Season's tooltips are getting an overhaul to include more info on each season
[*]Flowers tooltip is going through a similar process, as is the whole flower amount indicator
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1][list]
[*]game crashes when you obtain all mutations and try to roll for a new one
[*]game crashes sometimes when starting a new run
[*]If you obtain a sigil before it turns into a mutation, you get no mutation
[*]Sometimes the flowers in the main menu can suddenly change colours
[*]Some animation times are affected by frame rate
[/list]

[h1]How do I join the beta?[/h1]
The beta is open to anyone who owns the game on Steam, and can be accessed by going through a very simple procedure:[list]
[*]First, you right-click the game on your Steam library and select properties
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40748801/b3aaa054d7c4f06eec93d9094edd5e83880dab1f.png[/img]
[*]Then, you navigate to the "Betas" tab, where you select to opt into the public beta branch
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40748801/72cc6b1521c1b33a22cbe0a4a0e2a68e1ea41e95.png[/img]
[*]Your game will then be updated to the beta version, to play it, just click play as usual
[/list]
